title: Passive fallback tuner with gentle regional shedding and expanded telemetry (hotfix)
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: After INC-2026 we observed aggressive circuit flip behavior during quick regional degradation: nodes that briefly tripped a circuit were being force-evicted, causing KV cache loss and amplifying failover. This hotfix introduces a passive fallback tuner that prefers gradual deprioritization over hard eviction when a region shows transient failures, and expands telemetry so operators can see the fallback "score" and circuit transition reason. The change also fixes a race in controller rejoin logic that could clear a tenant's SLO reservation prematurely.

What this PR does (single-pass summary): adds a passive fallback mode in the runtime serving controller, implements a tunable scoring function for region deprioritization, emits new metrics and traces for circuit transitions, protects KV cache during transient passive fallbacks, and includes a conservative rollout plan (canary -> staged ramp).

Key behavioral changes: passive mode will: (1) compute a fallback_score per region (0..100) combining error-rate, p95 latency, and recent rejection spikes; (2) if fallback_score > soft_threshold, the region is deprioritized for new routing decisions but existing inflight requests are drained gracefully; (3) only when fallback_score stays above hard_threshold for a sustained window do we escalate to hard eviction/circuit open; (4) on rejoin we apply a warmup gate to avoid immediate reopening pressure. This reduces flip-flop and preserves KV cache for short blips.

Telemetry and observability: emits metrics: redwood.fallback.score, redwood.fallback.reason, redwood.circuit.transition, and a new tag region_hint for per-region breakdown. Console dashboard json included. Added tracing span annotations for passive->hard escalation.

Fixes: closes ENG-2148 (passive fallback spec) and mitigates symptoms from INC-2026 by preventing premature tenant SLO leases from being released (race fixed in serving/region/controller).

Checklist:
- [x] unit tests for tuner logic and scoring function
- [x] integration test that simulates transient regional error bursts
- [x] e2e smoke playbook for canary rollout
- [x] console dashboard and metric alerts updated
- [x] changelog / release notes entry

Rollout plan: canary 5% of traffic in us-west for 1 hour -> monitor rollback window; if stable, 25% for 3 hours -> 100% across regions over 24h. Default soft_threshold/hard_threshold conservative values are in config with operator overrides.

Risk and mitigation: behavioral change is additive and conservative by default (passive mode enabled via config flag and rollout gate). We preserved the existing circuit-open path and only escalate to it after sustained signals. Added additional unit/integration coverage to catch regressions.

Notes: there is a follow-up ENG-2201 to expose fallback_score in the public per-tenant telemetry slice and to add an alert that correlates fallback_score with token-cost anomalies.

release_notes:
- Introduce passive fallback tuner to gently deprioritize regions under transient load/errors instead of immediate eviction.
- New metrics: redwood.fallback.score, redwood.fallback.reason, redwood.circuit.transition.
- Fix race in regional controller that could prematurely release tenant SLO leases.
- Dashboard and e2e smoke playbook for canary rollout.
notes: Conservative defaults chosen to reduce customer impact; ops runbook updated. Follow-up work tracked in ENG-2201 for exposing per-tenant fallback_score to users.
